description: This Java test class 'LoanCOBAccountLockCatchupInlineCOBTest' contains integration tests for the loan cycle of the Apache Fineract platform. It particularly tests the behavior of Loan Close Of Business (COB) processes when loans are locked, verifying correct date updates during catch-up scenarios, and handling of inline COB execution. The class sets up test cases that interact with the REST API, create and manage loans, apply business date manipulations, lock scenarios, execute COB processes, and verify last COB dates are correctly updated under different lock conditions.

classes.name: LoanCOBAccountLockCatchupInlineCOBTest
classes.description: A JUnit Jupiter test class for testing various scenarios related to the COB process, locking behavior, and date updates for loans in the Fineract platform.
